name: Yellow House
source:
Sometimes it’s hard to figure out what is real and what is a phantom of a fevered mind.
Despite all the attempts to leave the past behind the aftershocks of childhood experiences keep haunting the lead character depriving him of all the rest. That made Artem face his fears and come back to his hometown – the cradle of his nightmares – looking for the only man who could understand him and was always there for him in his darkest hours.

 But the home ground meets Artem chilly: he starts seeing things in the gloom of a half-forgotten town, and all roads lead to a local landmark — a yellow house, which threatens to turn into a trap for anyone who crosses its threshold. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3023880/Yellow_House/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
有时很难分辨什么是真实的，什么是狂热头脑的幻影。
尽管尽了一切努力将过去抛在脑后，童年经历的余震仍然困扰着主角，剥夺了他剩下的一切。这让阿尔乔姆面对他的恐惧，回到他的家乡——他噩梦的摇篮——寻找唯一一个能理解他并在他最黑暗的时刻始终在他身边的人。

 但主场与阿尔乔姆的遭遇却很冷淡：他开始在一个半被遗忘的小镇的阴暗中看到事物，所有的道路都通向当地的一个地标——一座黄色的房子，它有可能成为任何跨过门槛的人的陷阱。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3023880/Yellow_House/]Steam[/url]]
